gaps.what: Stripe calls POST /api/webhooks from outside: the endpoint is set in Stripe's dashboard (README) or by `stripe listen` (package.json:10); no file of the project holds that call

Supabase Auth sends the browser to /auth/callback and /auth/reset_password: the project only hands it the URL (getURL, from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL or NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_URL), in emails Supabase sends and in the OAuth return; Stripe does the same with success_url, cancel_url and return_url
GitHub is reached by Supabase Auth, not by the project: the code holds the provider name 'github' (OauthSignIn.tsx:18) and the local Supabase configuration; a call from the app to GitHub is false

every form passes its server action as an argument to handleRequest (utils/auth-helpers/client.ts:18 calls requestFunc): the binding of a form to its action comes from the compiler's data flow, not from a name or a direct call

server actions return a path as a string and the browser navigates to it at utils/auth-helpers/client.ts:22; the path is composed by getToastRedirect with query parameters: the route reached is known only by following returned strings

/signin/[id] is one dynamic route; its five concrete views are strings of utils/auth-helpers/settings.ts (getViewTypes), and the redirects at app/signin/page.tsx:10 and app/signin/[id]/page.tsx:41 build the path from a cookie

file-based routing: no route path is written in a file; the path comes from the folder of page.tsx or route.ts and the method from the name of the exported function, which only Next.js's own listing gives

redirectToPath (server action) is called only when the router is null, that is when allowServerRedirect is true; it is the constant false (utils/auth-helpers/settings.ts:8), and the account forms and the navbar always pass a router: the edge is in the code and never runs

four functions are named createClient: utils/supabase/client.ts, utils/supabase/server.ts, utils/supabase/middleware.ts and supabase-js's own, imported in utils/supabase/admin.ts; a link by name joins the wrong ones

updateName writes full_name in the Auth user's metadata; the account page reads users.full_name, which only the trigger handle_new_user writes, at the insert of the user: the two are not the same store and a link from updateName to the users table is false
stripe.webhooks.constructEvent (app/api/webhooks/route.ts:33) verifies the signature locally with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: it is not a call to Stripe

the tables are named by string literals in supabase-js calls (.from('products')) and by joins inside select strings ('*, prices(*, products(*))'): a table link needs a reader of supabase-js calls; what a request really reads depends on the row level security policies of the schema and on the key used
the session cookies are read and written by @supabase/ssr through the get/set/remove callbacks of the three clients; the cookie name is not in the code
the trigger on_auth_user_created runs inside the database when Supabase Auth inserts a user: it is an entry point written in SQL, with no caller in the project

the emails (confirmation, magic link, password reset, email change) are sent by Supabase Auth with its own templates; locally Inbucket catches them (supabase/config.toml); the project has neither their text nor their sending
schema.sql is byte for byte the migration supabase/migrations/20230530034630_init.sql: one schema, not two
types_db.ts is generated by `supabase gen types` (package.json:18) and saved as UTF-16: a reader that expects UTF-8 finds no symbol in it; it is ignored by Prettier (.prettierignore)
utils/helpers.ts::postData posts JSON to a URL it receives and has no caller; components/ui/Input is imported by nobody: an HTTP client with no route to join and a component with no page

the schema publishes products and prices on supabase_realtime (last line of the migration) and no code subscribes; Twilio and S3 are only named in supabase/config.toml, disabled or experimental; supabase/seed.sql is empty: none is a node
the links to dashboard.stripe.com, vercel.com, nextjs.org, stripe.com, supabase.io and github.com in Pricing.tsx, LogoCloud.tsx and Footer.tsx are anchors, not uses of a service
package.json has no name and declares no Node version; the module is named after the repository; the lockfile is pnpm's while the scripts call npm and npx
no test and no CI workflow in the repository; the deployment on Vercel and the Supabase integration that applies the migration are described only in the README (no vercel.json)
the middleware matches every path that is not a static file or an image, the webhook included: it is not listed by a route, its matcher is a regular expression (middleware.ts:18)
the Stripe CLI and the Supabase CLI are launched by the scripts; the Stripe CLI is not in the manifest, the Supabase CLI is the devDependency supabase and its local stack needs Docker

run_and_observe cannot complete sign-in, checkout or the webhook: it needs a Supabase project or the local stack, Stripe test keys with the webhook secret, a GitHub OAuth app and a mailbox for the links
